prompts.en:
Use case: text-localization. Edit target: the existing English Salon de Six men's grooming landing-page image supplied. Supporting meaning reference: the Japanese original supplied. Replace the English wording only with the exact natural, polished marketing copy below. Preserve the same adult man's identity, face, pose, white shirt, the clinic photograph, navy/white/gold design, Salon de Six logo, typography hierarchy, telephone 098-391-8717 and 10:00–20:00 hours. Preserve portrait ratio and full composition. Fit copy by typography adjustments; do not cut words off. No invented claims or prices. English only except brand proper names.
Top small: "Men’s No. 1 Choice"
Brand: "Salon de Six"
Telephone: "TEL 098-391-8717"
Hours: "Open 10:00–20:00"
Navy intro panel: "Yellowing teeth, stubble, stray nose hair, untidy nails. Up close, the details make all the difference."
Large hero headline: "A well-groomed look makes a great first impression."
Gold framed offer: small navy strip "For men in their 30s and beyond" then main "Bangkok Men’s Grooming Package"
Man caption: "Salon de Six Ambassador" then "Model Keita Tanaka"
Bottom: "Look your best for work, dinner or a date." then "Face: beard, teeth, brows, nose and ear hair, skincare." then "Hands: unwanted hair and nails." then "All taken care of in just 90 minutes."
Use confident but refined English advertising typography, natural line breaks. Do not translate literally from Japanese. Preserve imagery and exact contact details.
